x-e-h2-04.s.s1.r.b: Lokhu kusondele eqinisweni elingahlolwa. Uma ukususa nalokhu, umgogodla wencwadi unyamalala.
x-e-h2-04.s.s1.r.c: U-'Nobody' wenza isimangalo ngabo bonke ngasikhathi sinye futhi wengamela abantu abakhathalayo.

x-e-h2-04.s.s1.explain: U-b ungumcimbi okufanele usale. U-a (isiqagelo sengqondo kathisha omkhulu), u-c (isimangalo ngabo bonke) no-d (usongo) yizingxenye abafundi abangathola kunzima ukuzethemba.
x-e-h2-04.s.s2.prompt: Gcina amaqiniso nesicelo, bese ubhala kabusha incwadi ngesiNgisi yabafundi bephephandaba (abazali, othisha nothisha omkhulu). Sebenzisa imisho engu-3 kuya ku-5, futhi ufake inkinga iklabhu ebhekene nayo nesicelo esisodwa esithile.
x-e-h2-04.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokubhala phansi izinto ezintathu zokususa embhalweni nento eyodwa yokugcina.

x-e-h2-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ucabanga ukuthi uthisha omkhulu angawufunda ngaphandle kokuzivikela?
x-e-h2-04.s.s2.modelNote.2: Icala lapho u-"nobody" asetshenziswa ngaphakathi komusho weqiniso.

x-e-h2-06.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa owodwa amalungu ethimba abezobuza ngawo ngemva kokufunda, njengo-"Yimuphi lo mhlangano?" noma "Ngokuyini ukuphendula?" (Noma kunemigqa eminingi enjalo, udinga ukukhetha eyodwa kuphela.)
x-e-h2-06.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi ilungu lethimba elithola le-imeyili okokuqala lingabuza futhi "Ngakho-ke?" ngomugqa othile.

x-e-h2-06.s.s2.prompt: Bhala kabusha i-imeyili ngesiNgisi, kuhlanganise nesihloko (Subject). Yenza ibonise ukuthi ngumuphi umhlangano, isizathu, lokho okucelayo, nesikhathi sokugcina sokuphendula. (Cishe amagama angu-60)
x-e-h2-06.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ubhale umugqa owodwa ngamunye wesihloko, isizathu, isicelo nesikhathi sokugcina, bese uzihlanganisa.
x-e-h2-06.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola njengohlu lokuhlola ukuthi ubhale 'ngumuphi umhlangano' no-'ngokuyini.'
x-e-h2-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Umuntu owamukela i-imeyili okokuqala angaphendula ngokushesha ngaphandle kokubuza futhi?
x-e-h2-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ungasho ukuthi i-imeyili imayelana nani ngesihloko kuphela?
x-e-h2-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngemva kokubuyekeza, ingabe isizathu (iklayenti alikwazi ukuza) sisadluliselwa?
x-e-h2-06.s.s2.modelNote.2: Ibhale isikhathi sokugcina njengo-"by the end of this week."

x-e-h2-09.title: Ukuthola isimo esifihliwe ku-'Kushibhile, ngakho ake sithathe ibhasi'
x-e-h2-09.goal: Khetha isicabango esingashiwo phakathi kwesizathu nesiphetho, futhi wenze ngesiNgisi isimo lapho isizathu siyiqiniso kodwa isiphetho singalungile.
x-e-h2-09.material:
Umfundi, uJun, uphakamisa indlela yokuhamba uhambo lwasemnyuziyamu.

Jun: "The bus is cheaper than the subway, so we should take the bus to the museum."

(Yilokhu kuphela uJun akusho. Akukho olunye ulwazi.)

x-e-h2-09.s.s1.r.a: Lesi yisizathu uJun asinikezile kakade. Isicabango esifihliwe yinto engashiwongo.
x-e-h2-09.s.s1.r.b: Lena umcabango wokuthi intengo kumele ibe nokubaluleka ukuze 'kushibhile' kubalwe njengesizathu.
x-e-h2-09.s.s1.r.c: Ukuthi imnyuziyamu ivuliwe kuyadingeka ngokulinganayo ebhasini nasesitimeleni esingaphansi komhlaba. Kuxhumene nokukhetha phakathi kwakho kokubili?
x-e-h2-09.s.s1.r.d: Lena umcabango wokuthi noma isizathu siyiqiniso, eminye imibandela kumele ibambe ukuze isiphetho silandele.
x-e-h2-09.s.s1.explain: UJun akashongo 'intengo iyabaluleka' noma 'ibhasi alimbi kakhulu ngesikhathi noma ngokusiza,' kodwa zombili kumele zibe yiqiniso ukuze 'kushibhile, ngakho ibhasi' kube yisiphetho. U-a uyisizathu esivele sashiwo, futhi u-c akanawo ukuhlobana nokukhetha phakathi kwezinketho ezimbili.
x-e-h2-09.s.s2.prompt: Bhala umusho owodwa noma emibili ngesiNgisi mayelana nesimo lapho isizathu sikaJun ('the bus is cheaper') siyiqiniso kodwa isiphetho ('let's take the bus') singalungile.
x-e-h2-09.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala phansi izinto ezimbili ngaphandle kwentengo ozinakayo uma uhamba (isikhathi, ukuphepha, umngani onenkinga yomzimba).
x-e-h2-09.s.s2.hint.1: Klama emugqeni owodwa isimo sebhasi lapho esinye salezo siyinkinga enkulu.
x-e-h2-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Esimeni osibhalile, ingabe 'the bus is cheaper' kusiyiqiniso?
x-e-h2-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ungachaza emusheni owodwa ukuthi kungani isiphetho singalungile kuleso simo?

x-e-h2-10.title: Ingabe umkhankaso wokuphinda usebenzisa wasebenza? Ukucabanga kabusha njalo uma kufika idatha entsha
x-e-h2-10.goal: Bheka idatha ekhishwe emasontweni amathathu, buyekeza isahlulelo sakho njalo, futhi uchaze ngesiNgisi ukuthi iyiphi idatha eshintshe isahlulelo sakho.
x-e-h2-10.material: Isikole siqale umkhankaso wokuphinda usebenzise amabhodlela epulasitiki. Ngaphambi komkhankaso, isilinganiso samabhodlela angu-120 ngosuku asuka ezibhodini zodoti ezijwayelekile, futhi angu-10 ayeya ezibhodini zokuphinda zisetshenziswe. Umbuzo ngokuthi, 'Ingabe umkhankaso wasebenza?' Uzobheka idatha iviki ngeviki.
x-e-h2-10.prereq.1: Izisho zesikhathi ezifana no-at first no-later
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.prompt: Funda idatha entsha iviki ngalinye futhi unqume isahlulelo sakho kuze kube manje.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.hint.0: Thola inombolo eyodwa entsha noma umcimbi eduzeni kwedatha yeviki lamanje.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola eyodwa ngeyodwa ukuthi isahlulelo sakho sangaphambilini sihambisana yini nedatha entsha.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.0.info: Iviki 1: Amabhodlela odoti ngosuku ezibhodini ezijwayelekile ehle asuka ku-120 aya ku-80.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ubheka idatha yeviki 1 kuphela, yisiphi isahlulelo esifanele?
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.0.after: Kuyiqiniso ukuthi amabhodlela anciphe ngeviki 1. Kulesi sigaba, kunengqondo kokubili ukubona njengo-'kwasebenza' nokusho u-'liyiviki elilodwa nje, ake sibuke isikhathi eside.'
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Lesi sahlulelo sisekelwe eqinisweni lokuthi inani lehlile. Cabanga futhi ngomkhawulo wokuthi liyiviki elilodwa kuphela ledatha.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Lesi sahlulelo esinakekelayo sisekelwe ebufakazini, ukuhlehlisa isiphetho esiqinile ngoba liyiviki elilodwa kuphela ledatha.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Kuyiqiniso ukuthi asele angu-80, kodwa uchaza kanjani ukuthi inani lehle lisuka ku-120?
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.info: Iviki 2: Uhambo lwesikole lususe abafundi abangu-100 kwabangu-400 kusukela ngoLwesithathu kuya ngoLwesihlanu. Amabhodlela odoti ngosuku: 70.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ungasibuyekeza kanjani isahlulelo sakho ngemva kokubona ulwazi olusha?
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.after: Njengoba inani labafundi lehle ngokwesine, akwenzeki ukuhlela ukuthi amabhodlela ehle ngenxa yomkhankaso noma ngoba kwakunabafundi abambalwa. Ukwehlisa ukuzethemba kwakho kufanelekile.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uma amabhodlela ehle ngeviki lapho kwakunabafundi abambalwa, hlola ukuthi umkhankaso kuphela yisizathu sokwehla.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Lesi sahlulelo sicabangela nenye incazelo, ushintsho lwenani labafundi.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uma abafundi abangu-100 bengekho, amabhodlela ambalwa angalahlwa nawo. Hlola ukuthi lolu lulwazi ongaluziba yini.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.2.info: Iviki 3: Bonke abafundi babuyile. Amabhodlela odoti ngosuku: 75. Ezibhodini zokuphinda zisetshenziswe manje kunamabhodlela angu-60 ngosuku (ayeba ngu-10 ngosuku ngaphambi komkhankaso).
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yisiphi isahlulelo esisekelwe kahle kakhulu ngemva kokubona idatha yokugcina?
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.2.after: Udoti 75 + ukuphinda ukusetshenziswa 60 = 135, okucishe kufane no-120 + 10 = 130 ngaphambi komkhankaso. Inani lamabhodlela alehlanga, kodwa ukuthuthela ezibhodini zokuphinda zisetshenziswe kuwumphumela womkhankaso.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Lesi sahlulelo sibheke kuphela iqiniso lokuthi inani alisondele ku-0. Ufunda kanjani inombolo ezibhodini zokuphinda zisetshenziswe?
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Uma ubheka ezibhodini zodoti kuphela, inani lehlile, kodwa qhathanisa isamba kuhlanganisa nezibhodi zokuphinda zisetshenziswe (75+60 no-120+10).
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Lesi sahlulelo siqhathanisa izamba zezibhodi zodoti nezokuphinda zisetshenziswe ndawonye.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.reflect: Isahlulelo sakho sashintsha kanjani iviki ngeviki? Uma sashintsha, qamba ucezu olulodwa ledatha (umusho owodwa) olubangele.
x-e-h2-10.s.s2.prompt: Bhala imisho engu-2 kuya ku-3 ngesiNgisi mayelana nokuthi isahlulelo sakho sashintsha kanjani. Sho ukuthi idatha yeviki liphi eshintshe umqondo wakho.
x-e-h2-10.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala umugqa owodwa ngokukhetha okukhethile iviki ngalinye, futhi uphawule lapho kushintshe khona.
x-e-h2-10.s.s2.hint.1: Lapho kushintshe khona, xhumanisa u-'because' nocezu olulodwa ledatha entsha.
x-e-h2-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ungabona isahlulelo sakho sokuqala, isizathu sokuzwathwa phakathi, nesahlulelo sakho sokugcina?
x-e-h2-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe isahlulelo sakho sokugcina sisekelwa izinombolo zedatha yeViki 3?
